# Cuthol

> Cuthol is a local, open-source non-linear video editor built for AI agents. An agent edits through a CLI (`cuthol`) or an MCP server (`cuthol mcp`, 14 tools): a magnetic spine and typed lanes, speech transcription and cleanup, captions, voiceover, loudness and ducking, clip effects and speed ramps, HyperFrames motion graphics composited with alpha, per-frame layout geometry, verification gates, frame previews that match the render, and a journaled undo for every change.

Start an agent with `guide(topic="overview")` over MCP, or load `skills/cuthol/SKILL.md`. Diagnostics read `[CUTHOL-Gxxx] what | Suggestion: next step`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/README.md): install, MCP client setup, features, configuration
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol/SKILL.md): workflow, rules and the order of operations
- [Editing](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol/references/editing.md): spine, lanes, trims, speed and ramps, effects, transitions, colour
- [Speech and mix](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol/references/speech-and-mix.md): transcription, cleanup, captions, voiceover, providers, normalize, duck, beat alignment
- [Compositions](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol/references/compositions.md): HyperFrames compositions, the `window.__cuthol` runtime, coordinate measurement and the geometry query
- [Verify and monitor](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol/references/verify-and-monitor.md): verification gates, every diagnostic code, frames, contact sheets
- [Extensions](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol/references/extensions.md): helpers, processors, effects, transitions, recipes, planners, speech and media providers
- [MCP](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol/references/mcp.md): tool and argument reference
